name: life-sciences-literature
description: Biomedical literature discovery across PubMed, PMC Open Access, bioRxiv, and medRxiv.

interface.shortDescription: Find biomedical papers, preprints, and open-access full text
interface.longDescription: Helps you discover and summarize biomedical literature using PubMed publication records, PMC Open Access availability, and bioRxiv or medRxiv preprints. Use it for focused searches, citation metadata, publication linkage, and source-backed comparisons between preprints and published articles.
